provenance.method: Manual public-source review and deterministic canonical structuring under DFV-002
transformations: Approved editorial material normalized into International Watch 1.0.0 records

records.headline: Italian connection requests and their presentation as a project pipeline
records.lead: Comparison of the approved Terna/ARERA request snapshot and the later Terna update.
agency_assignment: Applicants request grid capacity; the TSO records and plans around the queue.
quantifier_changes: Approximately 42 GW at March 2025 was updated to more than 50 GW at June 2025.
modality_changes: A request can be transformed editorially into a project or investment even though realization is not established.
temporal_generalization: A connection-queue snapshot does not establish capacity operational by 2030.
context_loss: Project maturity, financing, authorization and construction state can disappear when requests are summarized as investments.

observable_transformations.description: Administrative demand can be presented as realized or committed investment.

observable_transformations.source_segment: requests and modeled consumption use different metrics
observable_transformations.description: Metric and maturity qualifications can be lost.

analyst_notes: This records an observable category transformation, not an allegation about intent.
The later Terna record updates the same demand series and is not independent corroboration of realization.
